event.distribution_pattern: US Nationwide in the states WI, NC, FL, IL, TX, NC, CO, GA, and PA

products.product_description: Large Pitted Kalamata Olives, packaged in 4.4lb black plastic barrels. Labeling reads in part: Savor Greek Large Pitted Kalamata Olives, refrigerate after opening, these olives are mechanically pitted and may contain pit fragments, DR WT 4.4LBS (2kg)
products.product_quantity: 720 cases (4 plastic barrels per case), 2,880 plastic barrels
products.reason_for_recall: This voluntary recall has been initiated because Savor Brands Large Pitted Kalamata Olives may contain glass.
